description: Mutual fund / ETF portfolio from its latest public SEC Form N-PORT: top holdings by value (name, CUSIP, ISIN, LEI, shares, USD value, % of net assets, asset and issuer category, country, maturity/coupon for debt), asset-class / country / issuer / currency mix, top-10 concentration, net assets and monthly returns per share class. Look up by fund ticker (VOO, QQQ, BND), series id or class id. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fund-holdings

fund.description: Mutual fund or ETF ticker, SEC series id (S000002839) or class id (C000092055). Aliases: ticker, series

limit.description: Top holdings to return by absolute USD value (1-100, default 25)

name: fund_holdings
title: Fund Holdings
